chunk_pricing_policy_0.document:
# Pricing Policy

## Plans

### Standard Plan
- $99/month
- Up to 20 users

### Pro Plan
- $299/month
- Up to 100 users

### Enterprise Plan
- Custom pricing
- Dedicated support

## Discounts

### Non-Profit Discount
- 30% discount on Standard Plan

## Billing

### Pro-Rata Upgrades
When upgrading mid-cycle, customers are charged only for the remaining days in the billing period.

### Enterprise Pricing
Enterprise customers receive custom contracts and pricing based on seat count and requirements.

chunk_refund_policy_0.document:
# Refund Policy

## Standard Refund Window

Refunds are not available after 14 days from purchase.

## Exceptions

Refund requests may be reviewed when:

- Major service outage
- Billing errors
- Compliance-related issues

## Retention Offers

Support teams may offer:

- Service credits
- Temporary discounts
- Account upgrades

## Churn Prevention

Customers threatening cancellation should be escalated to the retention team.

chunk_sla_policy_0.document:
# SLA Policy

## Uptime Commitment

- Guaranteed uptime: 99.9%

## Incident Response

### P0 Incident
- Initial response: 15 minutes

### P1 Incident
- Initial response: 1 hour

### P2 Incident
- Initial response: 4 hours

## RCA

Root Cause Analysis reports for P0 incidents must be delivered within 24 hours.

## Service Credits

Customers affected by SLA violations may receive service credits according to contract terms.
